events.working_title: The Hotel Raid and the Agents' Arrival
events.why_here: The opening action—Trinity's ambush of the cops, the Agents' arrival, and their split to corner her—resolves when Trinity reaches Morpheus and the escape shifts from fighting to fleeing.

events.working_title: Trinity's Escape Across the Rooftops
events.why_here: Trinity's flight to a new phone ends when she escapes through it; the scene then pivots to the Agents discovering Neo, a new thread unrelated to her chase.

events.working_title: Neo Is Summoned and Meets Trinity
events.why_here: Neo's night of being contacted and drawn to the party concludes with Trinity's warning; the next scene jumps to a new morning and his ordinary life.

events.working_title: Neo's Capture at the Office
events.why_here: The workday sequence—reprimand, chase, failed leap, and capture—ends when Neo is taken into custody; the following scene is his interrogation, a distinct confrontation.

events.working_title: The Interrogation
events.why_here: The bug-implantation climax ends and Neo next wakes in his bed, revealing the interrogation as a constructed ordeal—a separate beat from his awakening and new summons.

events.working_title: Neo Chooses to Meet Morpheus
events.why_here: This run carries Neo from his waking summons through the car pickup to his decision to stay with the crew, one continuous movement toward meeting Morpheus.

events.working_title: The Red Pill
events.why_here: Arrival at the Hotel Lafayette reframes the question to 'will Neo commit to the truth?' — the meeting with Morpheus, the choice of pills, and the trace program that pulls him out of the Matrix answer that together. The unit closes when he blacks out, severed from the Matrix.

events.working_title: Born Into the Real World
events.why_here: The question becomes 'where does his body end up?' — a single continuous physical transit from the power-plant pod, through the waste line and sewer, into the hovercraft, answered when Morpheus welcomes him and he collapses aboard.

events.working_title: Waking in the Real World
events.why_here: Now the question is 'what is this place and what have they done to me?' — Neo regains consciousness, is rebuilt, learns the year is ~2197, and is led up to the main deck. The unit closes as they reach the deck where the full explanation awaits.

events.working_title: The Desert of the Real
events.why_here: The question shifts to 'what is the Matrix, really?' — the crew intro, jacking in, Morpheus's history of the Construct, the fetus fields, and the power plant, culminating in Neo's rejection and physical collapse back on the deck. This is one sustained revelation that ends when his body rejects the truth.

events.working_title: The Prophecy and the Operator
events.why_here: After the collapse, the story pivots to a new question — 'What is Neo's purpose here?' Morpheus reframes the rescue as the fulfillment of the One prophecy and promises training (sc-045), then Tank arrives to introduce himself, Zion, and the 'born free' concept before urging they begin (sc-047). This is the calm setup between the revelation and the actual training.

events.working_title: Kung Fu and the First Sparring Lesson
events.why_here: The training question begins — 'Can Neo learn to fight?' — with jujitsu loaded (sc-048), escalating through kung fu mastery (sc-049), the first sparring exchange (sc-050), the crew's reactions intercut with the fight (sc-051, sc-052, sc-054, sc-056), Neo being beaten and learning the rules are mental (sc-053), landing his first blow (sc-055), and concluding when Morpheus ends the spar and orders the next stage, the jump program (sc-057). The intercuts to the main deck are the same continuous action, not separate events.

events.working_title: The Jump Program
events.why_here: A new training stage begins — 'Can Neo free his mind enough to jump?' — marked by Tank grabbing the jump disk (sc-058), the rooftop setup and Morpheus's demonstration (sc-059), the crew's tense watching (sc-060), Neo's failed leap (sc-061), and the aftermath where he learns his mind makes the Matrix real and that death there kills the body (sc-062). This is a complete plan-execution-aftermath unit distinct from the sparring.

events.working_title: Trinity's Tenderness and Cypher's Scheme
events.why_here: The training concludes and the story shifts to a new thread — the interpersonal and political fallout. Trinity's private moment with the sleeping Neo (sc-063) flows directly into Cypher confronting her in the hall and planting the idea of the Oracle (sc-064). This raises a new question about loyalty and the coming betrayal, separate from the physical training.

events.working_title: Agent Training and the Sentinel Ambush
events.why_here: These scenes form one continuous action — Neo's combat training is cut short by Tank's distress call, launching the ship into a real Sentinel attack that runs through the evasion, the E.M.P. arming, the frozen wait, the machine's pass, and the crew finally falling asleep once safe. Cutting between the training program and the ship during this single crisis is one event; it ends when the danger passes and the ship goes quiet.

events.working_title: Cypher's Doubt Hardens into Treason
events.why_here: The question changes from survival to betrayal. Cypher's disillusionment, seeded earlier, is voiced to Neo (Morpheus got five others killed) and then consummated in the deal with Agent Smith to hand over Morpheus. This unit answers 'What is Cypher really doing?' — the two scenes are the setup and the payoff of the same turn, distinct from the Oracle mission that follows.

events.working_title: Departure for the Oracle
events.why_here: This unit answers 'How does the crew reach the Oracle, and what betrayal shadows the trip?' — Morpheus announces the visit, the crew enters the Matrix, Cypher drops the trace phone, and the car ride builds toward arrival. It is one continuous journey (ship → hotel → street → car), and it breaks where the car stops and Neo/Morpheus step out toward the building.

events.working_title: Arrival and the Threshold of the Oracle
events.why_here: The journey's arrival begins a new question: 'Will Neo believe enough to meet the Oracle, and what does she teach him?' The establishing building, the ascent, the elevator's revelation of Morpheus's faith, Neo's crisis of belief at the door, and the Spoon Boy's 'there is no spoon' lesson all serve that single unit, ending when Neo is finally summoned to see the Oracle.

events.working_title: The Oracle's Verdict
events.why_here: This is the private audience itself — the kitchen confrontation where Neo is told he is 'not the One' and given the lethal Morpheus choice. It ends when Neo is escorted out and Morpheus seals the private nature of what was said; the next scene moves the whole group into a car, shifting from revelation to reaction/departure.

events.working_title: Exit to the Real World
events.why_here: The group's departure — car ride, the 'welcome to the real world' beat, and arrival on the city street — is one unit answering 'how do they leave and what is their mood.' The boundary closes when they reach the hotel and the story pivots to a different question (the approaching threat), signalled by the cut to the operators receiving 'They're on their way.'

events.working_title: The Trap Is Revealed
events.why_here: Cross-cutting between the crew ascending the hotel and Tank on the main deck, this is one continuous action: the deja-vu glitch, the monitors seizing, Trinity's explanation, and Tank's 'It's a trap!' all converge on a single realization. It ends once the ambush is confirmed on both sides; the next scene shifts to arming up and the physical escape under threat.

events.working_title: The Ambush Springs (Mouse's Death)
events.why_here: This run is the trap executing: Neo is armed, the hardline is cut, Mouse is cornered and gunned down, intercut with Tank and Morpheus's helpless reactions to the killing. It closes once Mouse is dead (flatline), which ends the 'trap closing' unit and pivots to the survivors' escape problem.

events.working_title: Trapped, Morpheus Takes Command
events.why_here: With Mouse dead, the story answers a new question — how do the surviving three get out? Morpheus hears police, discovers the bricked-up windows, seizes Trinity's phone, and orders Tank to find a structural drawing. This is a distinct unit of the group regrouping under a new plan; it ends at the last scene given.

events.working_title: The Police Sweep / Tank Finds the Wet-Wall
events.why_here: The police begin methodically searching the building while, in cross-cut, Tank delivers the structural diagram and the wet-wall escape route. This closes the 'find us a way out' question with a concrete answer. The next scene returns to Agent Smith over Mouse's body, reframing around the Agents.

events.working_title: The Agents Converge on the Eighth Floor
events.why_here: Smith reports from the kill, the disconnected line lets him pinpoint the targets on the eighth floor, that intel flows to Brown, and the police swarm up the stairwell and flood the floor — one continuous tightening of the noose. It ends with the eighth floor overrun; the next scene shows the cops discovering the fugitives already gone.

events.working_title: The Fugitives Vanish Into the Walls
events.why_here: The cops find Room 808 empty with a man-sized hole, the crew is shown worming down inside the plumbing wall, and the Agents are left baffled over Morpheus's abandoned jacket ('Where are they?'). This unit answers 'where did they go?' The next scene restarts the hunt as a cop hears a strange sound, reopening the chase.

events.working_title: Ambush in the Walls; Morpheus Sacrifices Himself
events.why_here: A cop hears whispers, realizes 'they're in the walls,' gunfire erupts, and the confrontation climaxes with Smith attacking Neo, Morpheus diving in to pin him, and ordering Trinity to get Neo out as the crew escapes down the wall. One continuous action answers 'will they be caught in the walls?' The next scene lands the group in the basement firefight.

events.working_title: Escape Through the Basement
events.why_here: The crew crashes into the basement mechanical room, fights through gas grenades, and gets separated as Cypher disappears into the smoke — a distinct arrival-and-scatter beat. The next scene cuts back to Room 608 where Morpheus's one-on-one fight with Smith reaches its end.

events.working_title: Morpheus Is Captured
events.why_here: Smith breaks Morpheus's hold, the cops overwhelm and seize him, and Tank's horrified 'No!' on the main deck registers the loss — the aftermath and confirmation of the capture. This is the final unit in the sequence.

events.working_title: Regroup on the Street
events.why_here: The survivors reach the surface and re-establish contact with the ship, learning Morpheus is alive — a regrouping that ends once they know their destination and head for the exit.

events.working_title: Cypher's Betrayal
events.why_here: Cypher reaches the exit first and turns on the crew — his murder of Apoc and Switch, his confession, and Tank's return fire form one continuous act of treachery and its interruption.

events.working_title: The Survivors Escape
events.why_here: With Cypher down, Trinity and Neo make their final exit and wake aboard the ship, mourning Dozer — the aftermath of the betrayal that closes the sequence.

events.working_title: The Agents Take Morpheus Into Custody
events.why_here: The story leaves the ship and follows the enemy as Jones arrives and the interrogation of the captured Morpheus begins.

events.working_title: Mourning Morpheus and the Decision to Rescue Him
events.why_here: Back on the ship, the crew confronts the stakes of Morpheus's capture and Neo's choice to save him reverses the plan to pull the plug.

events.working_title: Smith's Interrogation Deepens
events.why_here: The focus returns to the captive Morpheus as Smith's philosophy hardens into a private, desperate drive for the Zion codes.

events.working_title: Tank Watches Over Morpheus
events.why_here: The action pauses on the ship as Tank guards the dying Morpheus, with an ominous establishing beat marking the lull before the assault.

events.working_title: The Assault on the Government Building
events.why_here: Neo and Trinity's infiltration erupts into open combat and their ascent through the shaft, a single continuous action intercut with the building's reaction.

events.working_title: The Agents Mobilize to Hunt the Intruders
events.why_here: The story cuts to the Agents' command response, a distinct beat where they shift from interrogation to actively hunting Neo and Trinity.

events.working_title: Rooftop battle with Agent Jones and the helicopter escape prep
events.why_here: The action moves to the roof where Neo and Trinity fight Jones, and the immediate aftermath is their scramble to get the helicopter flying — a single continuous fight-and-escape unit that ends once Trinity has the piloting program loaded.

events.working_title: The helicopter assault and Morpheus's rescue
events.why_here: Neo's gunship assault on the office, Morpheus's revival and leap, and the crew's survival of the crashing helicopter form one continuous rescue operation; it closes once all three are on the rooftop, having escaped the doomed aircraft.

events.working_title: Survivors regroup; Tank's realization and arranging the exit
events.why_here: After the rescue, the story settles into a beat of relief and regrouping — Tank's epiphany, the rooftop reunion, and Morpheus securing an exit — a distinct aftermath unit before the next threat arrives.

events.working_title: The Agents track the fugitives; Smith senses them
events.why_here: The focus shifts to the Agents on the roof who, having lost their targets, complete the trace and order a strike — ending on Smith's sudden, ominous reaction that sets up the next confrontation.

events.working_title: The subway escape foiled; Neo is trapped with Smith
events.why_here: The escape through the subway phones is interrupted by Smith's ambush — Trinity and Morpheus get out, but Neo is left alone facing the Agent, a self-contained sequence that ends with Neo cornered.

events.working_title: The crew urges Neo to run as he resolves to fight
events.why_here: The story cuts to the crew's helpless coaching and Neo's internal turn toward belief — a pause of tension and decision distinct from the physical combat that follows.

events.working_title: Neo and Smith's subway duel
events.why_here: The gunfight erupts into open combat, escalating through hand-to-hand to the third-rail showdown and Neo's surge of power — one continuous fight that ends with Neo breaking free and fleeing.

events.working_title: The Siren Sounds — Sentinels Arrive
events.why_here: A new threat interrupts the crew: Tank loses Neo, a siren blares, and Morpheus sees the sentinels on radar and orders the EMP charged over Trinity's protest. This is a self-contained pivot from the subway fight to the real-world danger. sc-187 cuts back to Neo's flight inside the Matrix, answering a different question — how will Neo escape on foot.

events.working_title: Neo's Foot Chase for an Exit
events.why_here: Neo steals a phone, calls the ship for extraction, and runs through the city while Tank searches for an exit and the crew urges him on, escalating to Smith firing at close range. The unit is Neo fleeing and the crew trying to get him out. sc-192 shifts the question from 'keep running' to 'here is the specific exit' — Tank pinpointing Wabash and Lake, Room 189.

events.working_title: The Exit at Wabash and Lake
events.why_here: Tank locates the exit (Room 189), then the market becomes a trap, Neo hits a dead-end alley, Tank spots 'the door,' and Neo kicks it open under gunfire. This run is unified by the single goal of reaching and opening that specific exit. sc-197 moves Neo up through the building — a new phase of the escape beyond the door.

events.working_title: Up Through the Building to the Fire Escape
events.why_here: Neo climbs the stairs, is steered by Tank's voice through the hall and out a window to the fire escape, lands broken below, and Tank confirms he's nearly at the fire escape. The unit tracks his vertical ascent and Tank's guidance. sc-201 cuts to Smith pausing in recognition of the hotel — a beat outside Neo's flight that reframes the pursuit.

events.working_title: Smith Recognizes the Hotel as the Sentinels Strike
events.why_here: Smith halts at the Heart O' The City Hotel, then the story cuts to the crew readying Neo's exit as the sentinels physically attack the ship — lights go red, the Nebuchadnezzar is struck, and Morpheus readies the EMP. This final run converges the two threats (Smith closing in, sentinels attacking) at the extraction point. It is the last material given.

events.working_title: Neo's run to the phone ends in Smith's ambush
events.why_here: sc-211 returns to the main deck and Trinity over Neo's body, moving from the chase-and-shooting to the grief-and-farewell beat; the preceding run (alley climb, window entry, the door-count race, the shot, and Smith confirming the kill) is one continuous pursuit ending in his death.

events.working_title: Trinity's vigil and Neo's revival
events.why_here: sc-216 cuts back to the hall where a transformed Neo stops the bullets, changing the question from 'can Neo be brought back' to 'what can Neo now do'; the unit sc-211–215 runs from Trinity taking his body through the monitors jumping back to life and her command to get up.

events.working_title: Neo sees the code and destroys Agent Smith
events.why_here: sc-219 returns to the main deck with the sentinels overrunning the ship and Trinity's desperate summons, shifting from Neo's display of power to the crew's mortal peril; sc-216–218 is one escalating confrontation ending with Smith's destruction and the other Agents fleeing.

events.working_title: The ship is overrun and the EMP is triggered
events.why_here: sc-223 jumps to the aftermath in the still, dark hovercraft with the threat ended and the two survivors reunited, a new situation; the unit sc-219–222 is the single continuous action of the sentinels attacking, Neo diving for the phone, and Morpheus turning the key that kills them.

events.working_title: Neo wakes and addresses the Matrix
events.why_here: This scene pivots from the battle's resolution to the film's closing statement; it is self-contained (reunion + the phone-call monologue), and sc-224 is the physical departure that follows, so it stands alone as the pivot.

events.working_title: Neo hangs up and takes flight
events.why_here: The final image — Neo stepping out of the booth and flying over the city — is the closing beat, a distinct unit that ends the film.
